tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures point to a siphon base field with history-dependent transient lag. The archive identifies competing source branches, and the available observations do not yet establish which branch applies. The targeted branch probe addresses that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations indicate both a sink-gradient base field and a coupled transient; the archive leaves the nonlinear source branch open, so fitting the linear-drive ODE alone is premature.
The trajectory batch has already increased the training set to eight rows; the remaining ambiguity concerns the source branch.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
